::: lead-text
I've taught ecology, biostatistics, animal behavior and Earth science at four CUNY and SUNY campuses, and my Brooklyn College course brings Hudson River field research into the classroom.
:::

## Courses

::: two-col
::: {}
**Brooklyn College, CUNY** · Lecturer, Spring 2026\
BIOL 9000 *Waves and Water Quality: Researching the Water Quality of the Hudson River* (lecture and lab). A course-based research experience I designed through the Research in the Classroom (RIC) Fellows Program, with support from the Hudson River Park Trust.

**Baruch College, CUNY** · Adjunct Lecturer, 2023–2026\
ENV 1003/1004 *Fundamentals of Ecology* (lab and recitation)

**Fashion Institute of Technology, SUNY** · Adjunct Lecturer, 2023–2024\
SC 211 *Earth Science*; SC 253 *Ecology and Environmental Problems*
:::
::: {}
**College of Staten Island, CUNY** · Adjunct Lecturer, 2021–2023\
BIO 272 *Biostatistics*; BIO 338 *Animal Behavior*; BIO 239 *Ecology*

**Earlier teaching**\
Tutor, Ivy Tutors Network, for the Oberlin College course *Coral Reefs: Biology, Geology, and Politics* (2018); substitute teacher, grades 6–12, Gifft Hill School, St. John, USVI (2017)
